The Storyteller

A lifetime woven
in stories

✦

What began as a bedtime story told to cousins, nephews and nieces under the starlit sky over the mud terrace of her native village, has now turned into the very essence of her being. Rajyalakshmi carries a lifetime of experience in storytelling, and children are the true joy of her work.

She dreams to transport souls of all ages to the land of tales and fantasies. When she puts on her hat, Story Aunty transforms into many characters, engulfing the children's joy and curiosity — one world at a time.

After twenty years of not only sharing stories but also collecting them, Rajyalakshmi seeks to continue spreading her exciting tales while always improving her craft. Her home of bedtime stories is now a walking roof that hovers over all the children she spreads her world to.

The Belief

Stories are how
children understand the world

📖

Communication

Through stories, children improve how they speak, listen, and connect — building language skills that last a lifetime.

🌎

World Wonder

Tales of mystery and adventure from around the globe give children a deeper insight into the world's wonders through lore and fiction.

✨

Imagination

Stories instill new possibilities, boost creativity, and teach children to see the extraordinary within the ordinary.

The Journey

Twenty years,
one story at a time

✦

Where it all began

Bedtime stories told under a starlit sky on the mud terrace of her native village — the first audience was cousins, nephews and nieces, wide-eyed and wondering.

Schools & Children's Programmes

Bringing stories into classrooms and community spaces, nurturing a love for reading and oral tradition in children across age groups.

Corporate Engagements

Conducted storytelling sessions for over 100 employees at multinational companies including PepsiCo, using narrative as a tool for connection and awareness.

Social Impact & NGO Work

Executed anti-tobacco awareness drives and worked with disability support and river rejuvenation initiatives — discovering the healing power of art and story.

Today & Beyond

Story Aunty continues to collect and share tales, meeting people of all walks of life, always learning, always spinning the next great story.

Offerings

Every space deserves
a good story

✦

Children's Storytelling Sessions

Immersive, character-rich live storytelling for children — in schools, libraries, birthday celebrations, and community events. Each session is a doorway into a new world.

Corporate Storytelling & Workshops

Narrative-driven workshops for adults and teams — building empathy, communication, and connection through the universal language of story.

Awareness & Social Campaigns

Using storytelling as a vessel for change — past work includes anti-tobacco drives and awareness programmes around disability and environmental causes.

Custom Story Experiences

Bespoke storytelling tailored to your occasion, audience, or theme. From cultural festivals to family gatherings, Story Aunty brings the tale to you.
